scope: Original-instruction arithmetic and control-flow comparison of pure timeline reader, independent analytical controls, and bounded application stream tests. This is not Cubase execution or ordinary full-project playback acceptance.

tests.initial_issue: Test-only Swift Testing #require call omitted inner try around nextBuffer. No tests ran in that first attempt. Corrected test syntax; production sources compiled. The second retained attempt passed.
tests.broader_scope: Root-run full application suite; separately observed log, not a target comparison.

oracle.origin: Independent original instruction model. Fraction/integer IEEE rounding; no candidate C calls or produced values used to generate expectations.
oracle.silence_partition_scope: Analytical start/end fields are retained in oracle rows but not compared for flags bit2; original branch skips those calculations. Frames and silence flag are compared.

conclusions: The scale is Double(Float32(RN64(1/period))); quantization is signed truncation after fused coordinate*scale+0.5, including negative coordinates.

The native start>requestEnd and end<originalRequestStart conditions are strict. End equality yields an empty half-open read. Invalid segment skips leave the cursor unchanged. Prefix silence can precede an empty read intersection.
Source seek is quantized offset plus cursor-minus-segment-start only when cursor is later. Checked sums/differences deliberately reject native wrap/saturation cases.
Mapped length is rounded separately from mapped start and capped by remaining frames. Silence bit2 bypasses start/end integer computation.
One transient read retry is allowed only at quantized segment start and before any retry. It repeats read, not seek. Other negative errors propagate; nonnegative short/long returns map to INT32_MIN.

Provider hookup and concrete PAudioSegment getter values match the retained direct original instructions; end performs a separate floating addition. This does not establish arbitrary CPR projection or live host ownership.

application_checks.synthetic: Three nonoverlapping synthetic segments include leading/interior silence, touching endpoints, nonzero offsets, nonunit gains, and separately rounded descriptor endpoints. Five partition sizes and boundary/gap seek suffixes match independently constructed exact PCM.
application_checks.real_fixture: Pinned LoFi CPR plus self-authored attached PCM24 stereo. All 2,116,800 output samples match integer-only signed24/2^23 encoding. The reference CPR, package original/report/media and unresolved event remain intact.
application_checks.proof_negatives: Fresh source/report/media tampering rejects preparation. Ordinary project render/export barriers remain. A derived CPR with nonzero serialized event start has its own valid source digest but remains unplaced and rejected by this mode.
application_checks.transactionality: Invalid rate/source/frame bounds, aliases, unsupported rounding and overflow reject. Failed stream block leaves cursor unchanged. Returned mutable buffers cannot mutate source samples.

limitations: No proprietary target execution, device-output capture, or Cubase export comparison.
Actual application mode uses the existing verified zero-origin source-event plan and explicit source-rate period. Wider synthetic reader descriptors do not broaden CPR admission.
Pure output structures are transactional; original native sample buffers may already contain prefix or partial writes on an error.
Native missing/unready accessor silence, I/O backend behavior, outer mapper retry, loop/locator expansion, observers and arbitrary provider replacement are outside the value kernel.
The direct immutable memory backend returns complete reads. It does not simulate transient disk errors; retry classification is tested independently.
AVAudioEngine worker scheduling and block size remain application policy. No full timeline mixer, routing, MIDI, plugin, automation or default Cubase scheduler conformance is asserted.
